# Wikivoyage

> > The free travel guide covering destinations worldwide with practical information for travelers exploring regions from the Caucasus to Siberia, China, and Europe.

Wikivoyage is a collaborative, wiki-based travel guide offering detailed destination information including attractions, transportation, accommodations, and cultural insights. The guide covers diverse regions with emphasis on practical travel advice for both popular and off-the-beaten-path destinations.

## Key Topics

- Russia travel destinations
- Caucasus region
- Ossetia (North and South)
- Black Sea coast
- Greater Caucasus mountains
- Ski resorts and winter sports
- Sochi Olympics venues
- Western Siberia
- Northeast China provinces
- Cross-border regions
- Mountain tourism
- Transportation guides
- Extra-hierarchical regions
- Cultural travel
- Regional geography

## Caucasus and Black Sea Region

- [Ossetia](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Ossetia): Travel guide for Ossetia region spanning Russia and Georgia in Caucasus
- [Krasnaya Polyana](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Krasnaya_Polyana): Ski resort and Sochi Olympics venue travel guide in Krasnodar Krai

## Siberia and East Asia

- [Altai Krai](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Altai_Krai): Western Siberia region travel guide covering Altai Krai, Russia
- [Heilongjiang](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Heilongjiang): Northeast China province guide featuring Harbin and ice festivals

## European Destinations

- [Frankfurt an der Oder](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Frankfurt_an_der_Oder): Brandenburg border town guide on Oder River between Germany and Poland
- [Çerkezköy](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Çerkezköy): Eastern Thrace industrial town guide on Orient Express route, Turkey
